name: Quer (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green with a white triangle with its base along the hoist, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Quer (a tower on red and an ear of wheat on white).
history: The arms of Quer were approved on 24 January 1992 and the flag on 21 March 2012; the flag is a rectangular cloth divided horizontally into halves, red above and green below, with a white triangle at the hoist and the crowned municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
